In Irvine, 17 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 17 dance and ballroom studios serving the Irvine market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 47 to 91. The AI engines name only four of the 17. The field averages 65 (D) on AI readiness, 17 of 17 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 10 of 17 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 18 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Irvine, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 17 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Bella Ballroom Dance Studio (91) and Arthur Murray Dance Studio Costa Mesa (86) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 47. Two scores are shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 65 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 17 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 10 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Two of the 17 are franchise locations (two Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #17 is 44 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Irvine.” Studios that serve Irvine from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (17 studios): bellaballroom.com, arthurmurraycostamesa.com, rfdance.com, arthurmurraylakeforest.com, dancecodeballroom.com, estebanconde.com, ocdancingballroom.com, swayballroomdance.com, atomicballroom.com, danceallyoucan.com, lavidadanceoc.com, cielo.dance, dancedalyballroomoc.com, ballroombeats.com, clubonestudio.com, alltherightmovesnewportbeach.com, danscene.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 18 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Irvine dance searches. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). OC Salsa's Google listing points to its instructor's site, which is rated here. Club One Studio shares a Costa Mesa suite with two brands whose sites are suspended. Left out: Century Dancesport in Tustin (its domain is disconnected, yet the AI engines named it in five of the Orange County ballroom answers), Marcelo's Salsa & Tango (its domain no longer resolves), instructors and class series with no studio address (dreamscometruedances, NS Dancing, LaRumbera), youth, K-pop and multi-genre studios that lead the broad answers (Pacific Dance, Focus Dance Center, S1L, M.A.D, Dance Lab OC, Dance Works, Avanti, AfterHours), and Evie Dance Studio in Pomona (outside this area).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 18 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Irvine, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Irvine, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini in temporary, unpersonalized chats, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 18 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons irvine ca”; “dance lessons irvine ca”; “salsa lessons irvine ca”; “wedding dance lessons irvine ca”; “ballroom dance lessons costa mesa ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in irvine ca” and “ballroom dance studio irvine”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
